newsitem.title: USA: Innovex stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Innovex stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Fidelity Magellan Fund manager Jeffery Vinik said Thursday it reduced its stake in Innovex Inc to 578,100 common shares, or 4 percent, from 5.4 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 185,000 common shares between January 17 and January 29 at prices ranging from $25.7291 and $31.9789 per share.
Innovex, based in Hopkins, Minn., is a maker of precision electromagnetic products.
